messages:
Jules Park: Partner sent a detailed excel + note. Theyre proposing a 'staged spot reclaim' + a tiered rebate for reserved commitments. Need to slot into our cost model inputs.
Rina Patel: Quick clarifying Q: is the rebate applied on invoice as % off reserved line item, or as a credit? our billing needs to know.
Melissa (BD): They said invoice credit; legal wants to ensure credits can be passed to end customers. I'll confirm.
Sam Ortiz: For simulation, I recommend representing staged reclaim as a vector: [t0-24h:100%, 24-72h:60%, 72-96h:20%, 96h+:0%]. Also a boolean 'extension_allowed' and multipliers for extension durations.
Jules Park: Good. Also note their rebate tiers are conditional on 'rolling 30d average consumption >= threshold' which is annoying but ok to model with moving-window checks.
Rina Patel: Data we need from partner CSV: sku, region, reserved_price_per_hour, spot_price_per_hour, min_commit_units, rebate_schedule_json (or flattened columns), reclaim_curve_hours, reclaim_extension_options.
Melissa (BD): I'll ask them to export two CSVs: pricing.csv and reclaim_schedule.csv. Reclaim schedule should include the staged percentages and extension costs.
Sam Ortiz: For cost model math: convert reserved savings to $/token by dividing total rebate over tenor by expected tokens served on that reserved capacity. We'll keep tokens/hour as param.
Jules Park: Edge case: if extension is purchased repeatedly, how do we amortize? Model as operational cost - add extension fees to spot consumption during reclaim window.
Rina Patel: I'll note that partners sometimes include early-termination fees that scale non-linearly if you exit <50% of tenor. Include early_term_multiplier.
Melissa (BD): Action items: I'll request the two CSVs + clarify invoice credit mechanics.
Sam Ortiz: I'll prototype a small simulator: inputs: reclaim_curve, extension_options, daily_request_profile, tokens_per_hour; outputs: expected reserved vs spot split and net $/token. Will commit to repo branch.
PartnerBot: Reminder: partner data privacy checklist required. Attach NDA if sharing detailed usage curves.
Jules Park: Thanks. Keep thread updated; want to present a summary to finance next Wed. :calendar:
